digest.component_or_area: bug-trend prevention program: observability, gates, migrations, and skill discipline
propositions: Bug provenance must be observable at creation and queryable via bug_trends metrics without requiring new user input.

Deterministic pre-LLM gates must exist for raw git writes, unread config fields, wall-clock asserts, unchecked AC checkboxes, stale code comment references, and oversized bug fixes lacking plan-review attestation.
Shell logic in reconcile-bridge, canary workflows, probe harness, and vote normalizer must be migrated to Python per strangler-fig pattern.
Canary and automation bug filing must follow hardened dedup patterns with documented bug-creation contracts.
Code comments citing dead SHAs, run-ids, or dates must be replaced with ticket citations and guarded by CI.
Oversized bug fixes lacking explicit review-plan attestation must be blocked by Gerrit before merge.
